# Gcore FastEdge

> FastEdge is a serverless edge compute platform for running WebAssembly applications on Gcore's global edge network.

- [FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge.md): FastEdge is a serverless edge compute platform for running WebAssembly applications on Gcore's global edge network.

## Get started
- [FastEdge overview](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/getting-started.md): FastEdge runs WebAssembly apps on Gcore's global edge network for personalization, authentication, and image processing.
- [Set up Rust for FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/getting-started/setup-rust-modern.md): Set up Rust for FastEdge using the Modern Rust SDK, WASI-HTTP, wstd crate, and wasm32-wasip2 target to build a cdylib WebAssembly library.
- [Set up Rust for FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/getting-started/setup-rust-legacy.md): Set up the Legacy Rust SDK for FastEdge by adding the wasm32-wasip1 target, configuring a Cargo project, and verifying the toolchain.
- [Set up JavaScript for FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/getting-started/setup-javascript.md): Set up the FastEdge JavaScript SDK to compile a fetch handler into a WebAssembly binary for edge deployment.
- [Set up Rust for FastEdge CDN apps](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/getting-started/setup-rust-cdn.md): Set up Rust for FastEdge CDN apps by adding the wasm32-wasip1 target, configuring a Cargo project, and verifying the toolchain.

## Applications

## HTTP Applications
- [Create FastEdge HTTP applications](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/getting-started/create-fastedge-apps.md): Build, deploy, and test FastEdge HTTP applications from a WebAssembly binary or template on the Gcore edge network.
- [Render Markdown at the edge](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/render-markdown.md): Deploy the FastEdge Markdown renderer to turn Markdown files into HTML pages at the edge using a configurable root URL.
- [Redirect visitors by location](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/geolocation-redirect.md): Set up a FastEdge geolocation redirect to send visitors to country-specific URLs using environment variables and Geo-IP data.
- [Build a FastEdge HTTP application](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/getting-started/get-started-http.md): Build and deploy a FastEdge HTTP application from a WebAssembly handler written in Rust or JavaScript.
- [Call an external API from a FastEdge app](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/getting-started/call-external-api-rust.md): Build a FastEdge app in Rust that makes outbound HTTP calls from the handler and returns parsed JSON.

## CDN Applications
- [Extend CDN functionality with FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/getting-started/integrate-cdn-with-fastedge.md): Extend CDN functionality with FastEdge by attaching WebAssembly applications to request and response stages.
- [Build and deploy a FastEdge CDN application](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/getting-started/get-started-cdn.md): Build and deploy a FastEdge CDN application by writing a handler, compiling it to WebAssembly, and uploading the binary.
- [Request and response properties](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/getting-started/cdn-properties.md): FastEdge CDN request and response properties can be read or modified with get_property and set_property host functions.
- [FastEdge application management](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/manage-apps.md): Manage FastEdge applications with metrics, logs, response headers, environment variables, secrets, and Edge Storage settings.
- [Create and manage templates](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/create-manage-templates.md): Create and manage FastEdge templates that package a WebAssembly binary with configuration for repeatable app deployment.

## Local development
- [Local development for FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/local-development/overview.md): Compare local development tools for FastEdge, including AI-assisted coding, a VS Code extension, and a headless test framework.
- [AI-assisted development for FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/local-development/ai-assisted-development.md): Use AI coding assistants to scaffold, build, and deploy FastEdge WebAssembly apps with the gcore-fastedge plugin and MCP server.
- [FastEdge extension for VS Code](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/local-development/vscode-extension.md): FastEdge extension for VS Code builds Rust, JavaScript, or AssemblyScript into Wasm and debugs FastEdge apps locally.
- [Test framework for FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/local-development/test-framework.md): Test FastEdge Wasm binaries in Node.js with a headless suite, assertion helpers, a visual debugger, and Vitest or Jest integration.

## Secrets Manager
- [Secrets Manager](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/secrets-manager/manage-secrets.md): Secrets Manager stores encrypted values for FastEdge applications, with steps to create, edit, delete, and link secrets.
- [Secret rotation with slots](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/secrets-manager/slots.md): Secret rotation with slots stores multiple encrypted password versions and selects the right slot by index or Unix timestamp.

## Edge Storage
- [How it works](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/kv-stores/how-it-works.md): Edge Storage for FastEdge is a globally replicated key-value store with local replicas at every edge location, compared with Cache.
- [Edge Storage](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/kv-stores/manage-kv-store.md): Create and manage Edge Storage key-value stores for FastEdge applications, including adding pairs, uploading files, and setting expiration.
- [BYOD, Bring Your Own Database](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/kv-stores/byod.md): BYOD connects FastEdge Edge Storage to an external Redis-compatible database so applications use existing data without migration.
- [Sorted Set](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/kv-stores/sorted-set.md): Manage Gcore Edge Storage sorted sets by creating, editing, and deleting members with numeric scores.
- [Bloom Filter](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/kv-stores/bloom-filter.md): Create, edit, and delete Bloom Filters in Gcore Edge Storage for fast membership checks on large datasets.
- [Cache](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/cache.md): FastEdge Cache is a fast key-value store for transient request-time state, atomic counters, and rate limiting at each POP.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/troubleshooting.md): Fix FastEdge application failures with 5xx error codes, debug logging, missing headers, and common runtime issues.
- [FastEdge CLI](https://docs.gcore.com/fastedge/fastedge-cli.md): Run compiled FastEdge Wasm binaries locally over HTTP with fastedge-run to test edge applications without deploying.
